# transmit_oncall_configuration (Resource)

An on-call configuration: the container for responders, teams, schedules and escalation policies that incidents route to.

~> **Destroying this resource only removes it from Terraform state.** Transmit keeps the configuration so incident history and integration URLs stay valid; delete its contents with Terraform, then remove it in the dashboard if you need to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "transmit_oncall_configuration" "prod" {
  name = "Production"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Configuration id.
- `paging_enabled` (Boolean) Whether paging is active. Any on-call change turns it off until a drill and re-activation in the dashboard.
- `revision` (Number) Revision at the last read. It moves on every on-call change, including ones made by other resources.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import transmit_oncall_configuration.prod 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001
```
